name: – After § 9 – Am 67
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 9a. Condemns the political instrumentalisation of the humanitarian crisis to spread racist and xenophobic narratives and undermine fundamental rights; expresses concern over the transnational amplification of dehumanising narratives on migration and recalls the particular responsibility of political representatives not to legitimise rhetoric that exposes migrants, racialised communities and children to hostility, discrimination or violence; is appalled by the racist attacks against migrants, including minors, in Ceuta, and expresses its solidarity with the victims and their families;
